description: This source file defines and exports a collection of plugin SDK facades, with functions to generate modules and type maps for various plugin subpaths, including dynamic loading, source resolution, and export analysis.

methods.name: pluginSource
methods.description: Constructs a plugin source string from directory and artifact basename.

methods.name: runtimeApiSourcePath
methods.description: Returns the runtime API source path for a given plugin directory.

methods.name: resolveFacadeLoadPolicy
methods.description: Determines loading policy for a facade entry based on source path.

methods.name: listFacadeEntrySourcePaths
methods.description: Returns a list of source paths for a facade entry, including exports from source sources.

methods.name: buildFacadeSourceModuleKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a source module based on its index.

methods.name: isPrimitiveTypeLike
methods.description: Checks if a TypeScript type is a primitive type or union of primitives.

methods.name: isArrayTypeLike
methods.description: Checks if a TypeScript type is array-like or tuple.

methods.name: normalizeFacadeSourceParts
methods.description: Parses a source path into directory name and artifact basename components.

methods.name: collectRuntimeApiPreExports
methods.description: Reads a runtime API file, parses declarations, and collects exported symbols for pre-export analysis.

methods.name: resolveFacadeSourceTypescriptPath
methods.description: Resolves the full path to a TypeScript source file, considering .ts and .tsx variants.

methods.name: resolveFacadeModuleResolutionContext
methods.description: Provides or caches a TypeScript program context for module resolution, considering tsconfig.json.

methods.name: resolveFacadeSourceExportKinds
methods.description: Analyzes a source file's exports to determine type and call signatures, cached for efficiency.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeModule
methods.description: Generates source code for a plugin SDK facade module for a given entry, handling dynamic imports and exports.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeTypeMapModule
methods.description: Generates a TypeScript interface mapping plugin subpaths to module types and export types.
